headline: Zayo petition to install fiber optic lines from Armory Street to Stafford Street.
summary: Zayo asks to install and maintain fiber optic telecommunication facilities in the public way at 409 Armory St. The lines would run from an existing hand hole on Armory St across from Grover St. to Utility Pole#1469/E1 on Stafford St.
items: Zayo petition to install and maintain fiber optic telecommunication facilities in the public way, 409 Armory St., from an existing hand hole on Armory St across from Grover St. to Utility Pole#1469/E1 on Stafford St.
location: 426 Armory Street (Boland Elementary School parking lot)
